verdict.rationale: Together AI provides an official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (github repo) and OpenAI-compatible API/SDK usage, with docs covering chat, structured outputs, function calling, streaming, fine-tuning, and dedicated deployment all launchable via API/SDK. This directly supports AI-native, agentic development against official SDKs, including agent loop patterns and tool calling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reviews specifically praising SDK quality/completeness, and no official Python SDK repo cited in evidence pack.
